source.kind: current model with explicit pre-change policy/navigation snapshot

definitions.close: players <0.40m apart and both <0.50m from ball
definitions.controlled_left_progress: last exclusive active-foot toucher is defender, ball moved >=0.25m toward its attacking end in that episode, defender still within 0.50m
definitions.stall: close encounter with ball staying within 0.06m of its local anchor
definitions.limits: Approximate 2D observations, not validated possession, referee results or physical tackles. Recovery and breakthrough can both occur in one run.
